full_judgment: 8. Besides this, the learned Advocate for the opposite party has cited a series of decisions beginning with the decision of the Privy Council in the case of Sanmukhsing and another vs. The King, Air 1950 PC 31, in which their Lordships of the Privy Council ruled in respect of which a charge of forgery has been laid against the accused had not itself been produced or given in evidence in a certain proceeding but, on the contrary, a copy of it had been produced the absence of complaint under section 195(1)(c) cannot operate as a bar to the trial of the accused.
